answer: By the comet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, split across independent auditors, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Work waits on the juniper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the grove of the next round.
